item.summary: The Review Meeting on the SVAMITVA Scheme was held today in New Delhi, with the Centre and the States committing themselves to complete the implementation of rural property ownership under the Scheme within the stipulated timeframe. The meeting was addressed by Union Minister of Panchayati Raj and Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying (FAHD), Shri Rajiv Ranjan Singh alias Lalan Singh and…
item.title: Union Minister Shri Rajiv Ranjan Singh Calls for Mission-Mode Implementation of SVAMITVA to Achieve Saturation by March 31, 2027
